description: This C# source file defines an Orleans grain class named ImplicitSubscription_TransientError_RecoverableStream_CollectorGrain, which handles stream subscriptions, processes incoming stream events with fault injection for testing recoverability, maintains internal state, and reports processing results. It includes fault injection mechanisms to simulate transient errors at various points in stream processing for testing purposes.
